title: Economy-to-climate coupling unit error saturates event probability; affects frozen Phase F evidence
description: The climate sector's GDP_SHIFT handler applies emissionsFactor = 0.00005 to gdpDelta denominated in USD. Summed across 11 nations at the configured 2.5%/tick growth rate, this yields 7.289e7 Gt of added emissions per tick versus the model's own baseline annualEmissions of 37 Gt (~2e6x too large). CO2 concentration consequently explodes to ~4.18e8 ppm within 50 ticks. temperatureAnomaly = 3*log2(co2/280) exceeds 9.2 by tick 4, pinning eventChance at its 0.5 ceiling in every arm.
root_cause: Unit/scale mismatch: a dimensionless factor (0.00005) is applied to a quantity denominated in USD to produce a quantity denominated in Gt of emissions. No dimensional reconciliation exists between economy GDP units and climate emissions units.
impact: Frozen Phase F (canonical causal-integration evidence) operated with eventChance saturated at 0.5 for ticks 4-20 of 20 (85% of horizon). Its control-vs-intervention contrast derives from the 3-tick pre-saturation transient plus stochastic event timing, not a sustained CO2 dose-response.
EXP-002 v1 threshold scan (50/40/90) invalid: contaminated RNG pairing plus saturated system.
EXP-002 v2 threshold scan (0/50/70) reproducible but invalid as dose-response: measures stochastic event-timing sensitivity in a saturated regime.
JAMIA manuscript evidence matrix cites Phase F causal pathway results that are materially qualified by this defect.
not_a_nonconformity: This defect was not introduced by EXP-002 work. It is pre-existing and present in frozen Phase F artifacts.

impact_assessment.mode: common-mode in mechanism, comparison-destroying in effect

common_mode_tick3_co2.note: Explosion term is near-identical across arms despite 520 ppm initial separation.

impact_assessment.phase_f_not_an_overclaim: Frozen report.md self-classifies as 'E - Null stochastic result' and states the >=80% direction-consistency criterion was NOT MET. The defect does not create a false positive; it renders the honest null uninterpretable, because the intended treatment contrast was absent for 85% of the horizon.
impact_assessment.recommendation: C (correct implementation + new Phase F version) with a D-component (dimensional-consistency audit of all cross-sector couplings). Frozen Phase F artifacts must be preserved as the historical record.
impact_assessment.provenance_gap_noted: experiment-results/phase-f/ and docs/PHASE-F-DESIGN.md are untracked in git; freeze is enforced by convention, not version control. Recommend committing or hashing into a manifest.

corrective_action_proposed: Option 1 (recommended): re-derive emissionsFactor so a 2.5% GDP growth delta yields a realistic emissions increment (order 0.1-1 Gt/tick); re-run Phase F. Blast radius: Phase F artifacts, QMS records, manuscript evidence matrix, Zenodo package.
Option 2: clamp climate state to a physically bounded CO2/anomaly range. Still alters frozen behaviour.
Option 3: narrow the manuscript claim to the pre-saturation transient with explicit disclosure.
